biggest_catch: Long Election Day: at the precinct by 6 AM with several hours of closeout after 7 PM polls closing; first-time workers must also attend classroom training.
catches: Poll Workers receive $200 and Inspectors receive $250 for each Election Day.
Must be at assigned precinct no later than 6:00 AM; polls close at 7:00 PM.
After-7 PM closeout (reports, packaging, return to courthouse) 'can take several hours.'
First-time workers are required to attend a classroom training session (duration not published).

steps: Apply to be a poll worker with Madison County elections.
Receive appointment letter with available training sessions (first-time workers attend classroom training).
Report to assigned precinct by 6:00 AM on Election Day.
Serve through polls closing at 7:00 PM plus several hours of closeout.
timing: Arrive by 6:00 AM; polls close 7:00 PM; closeout 'can take several hours' (est. end 9-11 PM).
weasel_words: Closeout end time is estimated from 'several hours'; no exact time is published.
First-time classroom training is required but its duration is not published, so it is not counted.
Inspector ($250) is a separate role and is not part of this route.
